title: llm.toolcall.executed.v3
description: Audit fact (D-26, FR-54, synthwerk#53): the admin AI called one read-only MCP tool. llm emits it for every call of an org-scope tool; identity shows it in the org audit list. Replaces llm.toolcall.executed.v2 (deprecated, never produced): data.org_id names the identity org, so identity can list the call. CloudEvents orgid: data.org_id. Subject: the conversation id. The actor extension names the user (user:<sub>). No tool arguments and no tool results: they can hold personal data.

scope.description: Token scope of the tool (D-14, D-44). llm emits this fact for org tools. user and operator stay for later producers.

org_id.description: Identity org id (UUID). Equals the orgid extension.

conversation_id.description: The conversation the call ran in. Equals the subject.

outcome.description: ok: the tool answered. denied: the scope or the membership did not allow the tool, or the model sent arguments the tool does not take. error: the tool failed.
